+		}

+		return data, nil
+	}

index 271a869..853a603 100644
--- a/internal/config/config_test.go
+++ b/internal/config/config_test.go
@@ -215,6 +215,63 @@ func TestLogEncoding(t *testing.T) {
 	}
 }
 
+func TestLoadEnvironmentReferences(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_PORT", "8085")
+	t.Setenv("_FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_LEVEL2", "DEBUG")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_ENCODING", "json")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_TTL", "90s")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_FILE", "/tmp/flipt.log")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_EMPTY", "")
+
+	const missing = "FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_UNSET_FOR_TEST"
+	_, exists := os.LookupEnv(missing)
+	require.False(t, exists)
+
+	path := t.TempDir() + "/config.yml"
+	err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`log:
+  level: '${_FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_LEVEL2}'
+  encoding: '${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_ENCODING}'
+  file: '${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_FILE}-suffix'
+  grpc_level: '${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_UNSET_FOR_TEST}'
+  keys:
+    time: '${1INVALID}'
+    level: '${FLIPT-CONFIG-REF-FILE}'
+    message: '${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_EMPTY}'
+server:
+  http_port: '${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_PORT}'
+  grpc_port: 9010
+cache:
+  ttl: '${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_TTL}'
+`), 0600)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	check := func(t *testing.T, port int, encoding LogEncoding) {
+		t.Helper()
+		result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, "DEBUG", result.Config.Log.Level)
+		assert.Equal(t, encoding, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
+		assert.Equal(t, "${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_FILE}-suffix", result.Config.Log.File)
+		assert.Equal(t, "${FLIPT_CONFIG_REF_UNSET_FOR_TEST}", result.Config.Log.GRPCLevel)
+		assert.Equal(t, "${1INVALID}", result.Config.Log.Keys.Time)
+		assert.Equal(t, "${FLIPT-CONFIG-REF-FILE}", result.Config.Log.Keys.Level)
+		assert.Empty(t, result.Config.Log.Keys.Message)
+		assert.Equal(t, port, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+		assert.Equal(t, 9010, result.Config.Server.GRPCPort)
+		assert.Equal(t, 90*time.Second, result.Config.Cache.TTL)
+	}
+
+	t.Run("references and type conversion", func(t *testing.T) {
+		check(t, 8085, LogEncodingJSON)
+	})
+
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "9095")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_ENCODING", "console")
+	t.Run("configuration key environment overrides", func(t *testing.T) {
+		check(t, 9095, LogEncodingConsole)
+	})
+}
+

 		name         string
